high_level_description: This image is a meme featuring three panels from the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). The top panel shows Thanos from "Avengers: Infinity War," with the text "I AM INEVITABLE" overlaid on his image. The middle panel features Tony Stark/Iron Man from "Avengers: Infinity War," with the text "I AM IRON MAN!!" overlaid. The bottom panel shows Doctor Strange from "Doctor Strange," with the text "I WROTE THESE LINES, I'M A GENIUS!!" overlaid. The setting of each panel appears to be from the respective movie scenes,
